nodes.label: PUT /auth/switch-role - Switch Active Role
nodes.rationale: Switching role re-issues the JWT with level, role and the resolved permission list embedded in the token payload, so downstream authorization reads permissions from the token rather than querying the ACL tables per request.

edges.source_location: put.requestBody role_id matches the ACL role_id path parameter
issued JWT payload embeds permissions such as user:create, role:read, permission:delete
